title: Corpus 2025
description: A Minecraft modpack for Corpus Community
body:
~~This modpack was created for Corpus Community's annual Minecraft phase!

It is a lightly technical modpack with excellent terrain generation and decorative blocks.

"After the fall of the great Communist Union, survivors and adventurers set forth into a new land to rebuild. United by an oath to never again let the world collapse into chaos, they vowed to thrive through trade, cooperation, and community. Here, medieval towns and villages will rise - not of stone and timber alone, but strengthened by technology and power, where industry works hand-in-hand with tradition.

Each settlement is bound by the Great Railway, a lifeline of travel, trade, and diplomacy leading to the central hub. Every settler chooses a profession - farmer, miner, engineer, brewer, and beyond - contributing their craft to the prosperity of the realm.

Weekly mayor elections will guide collaborative projects and create competitions."
~~
